descriptions.success: A merchant with your build takes the last slot, and {worker_name} spends the hour on shoulders that could almost be yours, careful and unhurried, working out knots as if tenderness could be kneaded into someone else's back and still somehow reach you. The merchant, mistaking longing for luxury, pays the full premium.

The merchant leaves swearing no hands in the city pay attention like these, books a standing appointment, and sends two friends before the week is out. None of them will ever know whose shoulders those hands were really reading.
descriptions.mediocre: Halfway through, the likeness cuts the other way; the differences pile up and the tenderness drains out of the session. Competent work, ordinary tip.
descriptions.failure: Halfway down the spine the illusion collapses, this back is not yours and never will be, and {worker_name} finishes the hour hollow and mechanical. The merchant senses being a stand-in for someone and does not care for it at all.

descriptions.success: A client limps off the table shouting that the massage wrenched something, angling for a refund and hush money on top. {worker_name} has seen the act before and, because your ledger might as well be a shared one, calmly points out the week-old bruises the towel had been covering. The scam dies on the spot and the client pays in full to escape the embarrassment.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} does better than killing the claim: names the two other houses the schemer has bled with the same performance, loud enough for the whole waiting room. The room applauds the theatre, the story travels, and by evening your parlor is known as the one house in the district you cannot cheat.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} smells the act but cannot prove it, and settles for waiving the tip instead of paying out. The house limps away roughly even.
descriptions.failure: The performance is good, and {worker_name} second-guesses the instinct one breath too long. You end up covering a refund for an injury that never happened, and what gnaws at {worker_name} all evening is not the coin, it is your face when you signed it over.

descriptions.success: The new amphora of almond oil sits wrong on {worker_name}'s palms, too thin, too quick to vanish into the skin, and a friend does not let that slide. One visit to the supplier with the evidence still glistening on one hand, and the month's order arrives replaced, apologized for, and discounted. The clients get the real thing and your house keeps its name.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} goes further and audits three months of deliveries against the stockroom, uncovering a pattern of shortweighting older than the cut oil. Rather than see that ledger reach the guild, the supplier settles the difference on the spot and hands over the good pressing at cost for a season. It gets brought to you like a trophy.
descriptions.mediocre: The oil is off but the proof is thin, and the supplier shrugs it into a dispute about storage. {worker_name} quietly swaps the batch for house stock and the day earns what it earns.
descriptions.failure: {worker_name} storms the supplier's stall on a wrong hunch, the batch tests clean, and the accusation burns the goodwill discount you spent a year earning. The walk back to the parlor is long, most of it spent rehearsing how to tell you.

descriptions.success: {worker_name} runs a private loyalty scheme on your clock: favorite clients get the half hour quietly stretched to a full one, no charge, and repay it in tips that never touch the book. Today the sleight of hand holds; the room hums, the favorites glow, and the ledger looks almost honest.
descriptions.critical_success: One of the freeloaded favorites turns out to be a magistrate who remembers generosity. A word in the right ear sends a knot of wealthy new clients to your door asking for {worker_name} by name, and not even skimmed arithmetic can ruin a day like this.
descriptions.mediocre: The free extension runs long and the tip runs short. The favorite floats out delighted; the day's totals do not.
descriptions.failure: Two paying clients wait past their hour while a favorite dozes through a free second one, and both walk out loudly, taking a regular with them. The hole in the day's take is yours to absorb, and {worker_name} shrugs it off as the cost of being adored.

descriptions.success: The imported oil drops faster than the bookings explain because {worker_name} uses it for off-book sexual finishes after hours. Tonight slick fingers masturbate a client to orgasm, and the extra fee goes into the wrong pocket while your ledger records only an ordinary massage.

descriptions.mediocre: The flask runs dry mid-appointment and the switch to house oil is anything but smooth. The client finishes, frowning at the difference, and the side fee shrivels in the awkwardness.
descriptions.failure: Your best-paying regular books the premium oil service and gets the watered house blend, because the good bottle is empty again. The friction is literal, the complaint is loud, and the refund comes out of your till while the missing oil stays missing.

The client leaves triple coin and a standing booking, buying the echo of a desire that remains yours.

descriptions.failure: Halfway through, the hands go honest. They stop performing, settle still and warm on the client's back, and {worker_name} says quietly that this tenderness belongs to someone. The client lies there a long moment, then dresses, presses {worker_name}'s hand in both of theirs, and leaves without paying and without anger. Whoever it is, they say from the door, is luckier than they know.

descriptions.success: What the clients buy from {worker_name} is a copy: the warmth, the undivided attention, the sense of being the only body in the world, all of it drafted from an original kept for you. The copy is still finer than anything the competition sells. {worker_name} works the full board for the house you are building and hands over the take like it is a letter.
descriptions.critical_success: A grieving client books quiet company after the rub, and {worker_name} lends out the borrowed tenderness so faithfully that the client weeps, pays double, and endows a weekly slot. Crossing the room afterward, {worker_name} glances at you once, and you understand exactly whose warmth was on loan tonight.
descriptions.mediocre: Keeping the original and selling the copy takes bookkeeping of the heart, and today the accounts wobble. The client senses the attention arriving secondhand and pays accordingly.
descriptions.failure: The client asks, kindly, who the tenderness is really for, and the hands stop pretending. {worker_name} answers with the truth, or enough of it, and the client nods like someone recognizing an old ailment, waves off the unfinished hour, and forgives it on one condition: that {worker_name} tell that person someday. Nothing lands in the till, and {worker_name} walks lighter anyway.

descriptions.success: People tell a masseuse things they would never tell a partner; something about good hands unlocks the jaw. {worker_name} listens all shift with a friend's ears tuned to your interests and brings you the useful sediment at close: which rival is short on coin, which official is buying, which regular is circling a deal. The rub money is good. The intelligence is better.
descriptions.critical_success: A rival house's steward, boneless and unguarded on the table, talks through an entire scheme to poach your best clients with a week of free services. {worker_name} keeps the pressure soothing and the questions innocent until the whole plan is laid out along with the steward, then brings it to you the way friends bring warnings: before it costs anything.

descriptions.success: {worker_name} runs a flawless book all day, then bolts the door at close and points at the table: your turn. All week you have been rolling your neck over the ledgers, and a friend keeps count of things like that. Ten minutes into the best massage in the house you finally admit how heavy the season has been, and when you get up, the ledgers seem smaller.
descriptions.critical_success: With your face in the headrest and your shoulders finally unlocking, {worker_name} talks through the whole roster from memory, who is fading, who is ready for harder shifts, which client is not worth the trouble, and by the time the knots are gone you have next month planned better than any meeting ever managed. The day's take was the best this week; the half hour after close was worth more.
